tools.name: get_ar_food_headline
tools.description: Free: latest Argentina food & beverage price index value + 30-day rate, source-cited and updated daily. Optional method: jevons (default, recommended), carli, or trimmed. For the full daily series use get_ar_food_price_index.

tools.name: get_ar_food_methods
tools.description: Free: methodology comparison — the latest Argentina food & beverage index under every estimator (Jevons geometric mean, Carli arithmetic mean, trimmed mean), all computed from the same underlying data. Zero cost.

tools.name: get_ar_food_price_index
tools.description: Returns the full daily Argentina food & beverage price index time series (base=100). Source-cited from public retailer prices, updated daily, methodology published.
